other_events.A_1280_inference_sensitivity: failed twice (CUDA OOM). Cause diagnosed after the second failure: Ultralytics predict treats a list source as one batch and ignores batch=, so each 256-image chunk was one batch. Per the stop rule this stage is not retried in this task. remote.py now sends chunks equal to the prediction batch (16 at 640, 4 at 1280) for the remaining stages.
other_events.A_640_inference: therefore ran with an effective prediction batch of 256 images (identical letterbox shapes; outputs not expected to depend on batch).
